video_title: Training Camp Media Availability | October 1, 2026 | OKC Thunder

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on the character and work ethic of OKC rookies
quotes.excerpt: Once you have that type of mindset combined with the work ethic and the skill they have
quotes.quote: The good thing about our rookies this year, and that has been every year, is the character. They are super good guys that want to work, they want to get better, they want to learn. Once you have that type of mindset combined with the work ethic and the skill that they have, the sky is going to be the limit for the rookies.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams likes the mindset of the Thunder rookies this year. He says they are super good guys who want to work and learn, and with their skill set, the sky is the limit for them.

quotes.speaker: Jaylin Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylin Williams on his growth and comfort as a veteran player
quotes.excerpt: I definitely feel more comfortable as I'm getting older. I know what's expected of me
quotes.quote: I definitely feel more comfortable as I'm getting older. I know what's expected of me, I know what's expected for the team, I know what practice is going to look like. I feel like I'm stepping into that older guy vet role on the team and I'm trying to do what I can to help the younger guys lead in the right way.
quotes.social_post: Jaylin Williams says he is feeling more comfortable as he steps into an older guy vet role for the Thunder. He is focused on helping the younger players lead in the right way.

quotes.speaker: Jaylin Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylin Williams on the significance of his street sign in Fort Smith
quotes.excerpt: It says Jaylin Williams on the sign, but I hope my family is able to say that's our
quotes.quote: It was awesome. The street runs in between the gym that I played in and what we call the girls gym, so it's in between the school. I have videos on my phone from when I was in high school, me and my homeboys walking on that same street or that same area. It was a surreal thing. To me, it says Jaylin Williams on the sign, but I hope my family is able to say that's our family street sign, the Williams family.
quotes.social_post: Jaylin Williams reflects on having a street named after him in his hometown. He says it is a surreal thing and hopes his family sees it as a sign for the whole Williams family.

quotes.speaker: Jaylin Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylin Williams on his defensive development and earning a starting role
quotes.excerpt: Mark told me that you have to get better at this if you want to get on the court
quotes.quote: Honestly, I just wanted to get on the court. Mark told me that you have to get better at this if you want to get on the court, and I'm a competitor and I wanted to do whatever it took to get on the court. I was down in the G League and back to here and not playing in the G the next morning, so I finally just said I got to figure something out and luckily I did and I just wanted it.
quotes.social_post: Jaylin Williams on his defensive development and path to the rotation. He says he was a competitor who just wanted to get on the court, so he had to figure out what Mark Daigneault needed from him to make it happen.
